svg.title: ANULUM — complete named-project atlas, work in progress
svg.desc: Every named source project and component appears as a separate entry. Group containers indicate catalogue responsibility. Technical relations are separate and source-bound. All work is in progress; release availability and qualification remain separate facts.

g.title: DIRECTOR-AI: Response-level guardrail for LLM output: NLI and retrieval grounding, sealed evidence packets and an optional streaming contradiction halt.

REMANENTIA: Local-first, auditable memory for AI agents and knowledge-intensive software: project-file indexing, hybrid retrieval, consolidation and an entity graph, through a CLI, an MCP server and an HTTP API.
RIGOR-FOUNDRY: Evidence-bound repository auditing: inventories Git-tracked content, emits reproducible audit candidates, binds review decisions to exact evidence and prepares remediation inputs.
SYNAPSE-CHANNEL: Local-first coordination bus for AI agents: presence, file-scope work claims, messages, task status, receipts and an audit journal on one hub.
HushLine: Local command-output filter: runs a command, then limits, shapes and redacts its output before it reaches a caller. Four independent cores: Go, Rust, Python and Node.

DIRECTOR-CLASS-AI: Action control between an autonomous agent and its effectors: action-policy checks, human approvals, gateway enforcement and tamper-evident action evidence. Contents are not published. Licence: Not published
g.text: In progress · Contents are not published.

g.title: SYNAPSE-CHANNEL-FLEET: Multi-machine operation of the bus: durable follower daemon, per-peer trust and configuration, claim forwarding and diagnostics. Contents are not published. Licence: Not published
g.text: In progress · Contents are not published.

g.title: DIRECTOR-AI-CLOUD: Control plane for a hosted Director-AI API: accounts, API-key lifecycle, usage metering, plan quotas and operator exports. Contents are not published. Licence: Not published
g.text: In progress · Contents are not published.

g.title: REMANENTIA-PORTAL: Account and billing or licence-request portal for the product family. It runs no customer workload. Contents are not published. Licence: Not published
g.text: In progress · Contents are not published.

g.title: SYNAPSE-POLICY-CHECK-ACTION: GitHub Action that checks a SYNAPSE CHANNEL release receipt against a policy file in CI.
SCPN-QUANTUM-CONTROL: Integrated modelling, simulation, compilation, gradients, control, provider workflows, analysis and Quantum Studio.
oscillatools: Classical coupled-phase-oscillator dynamics, observables, sensitivities and control-oriented numerical tools.
scpn-quantum-engine: Optional Rust/PyO3 numerical acceleration and native computation used by supported workbench paths.
SCPN-QC-AD: Whole-program automatic differentiation, derivative transforms, batching, optimisation and explicit supported-path contracts.
SCPN-QC-ANALYSIS: Observables, synchronisation witnesses, result analysis and the open-data DLA-parity pathway.
SCPN-QC-APPS: Domain application adapters, quantum randomness, cryptography and sensing workflows, with explicit claim boundaries.
SCPN-QC-BENCH: Workload-specific benchmark suites, comparison harnesses, campaign reproduction and retained run evidence.
SCPN-QC-COMPILER: Model and circuit frontends, intermediate representations, interchange and code generation.
SCPN-QC-CONTRACTS: Versioned parameter, result, semantic and evidence interface contracts shared by components. Contents are not published. Licence: Not published
g.text: In progress · Contents are not published.

g.title: SCPN-QC-CONTROL: Feedback and co-design, chimera and topology-aware control, and DLA-constrained control paths.
SCPN-QC-CORE: Configuration, logging, resource budgets and generic Kuramoto-XY problem foundations, separated from paper-specific research assumptions.
SCPN-QC-HAL: Provider-neutral workloads, capabilities, job/result contracts and optional provider adapters.
SCPN-QC-LEARN: Forecasting, quantum neural models, surrogate models, kernels and variational learning paths.
SCPN-QC-MITIGATION: Error-mitigation implementations and their method taxonomy.
SCPN-QC-QEC: Quantum error-correction analysis and fault-tolerant resource-reporting surfaces.
SCPN-QC-QNODE: Quantum tapes, gradient execution and framework bridges for supported Qiskit, PennyLane, JAX, PyTorch and TensorFlow paths.
SCPN-QC-RESEARCH: Experimental SCPN theory, paper-specific assumptions and research adapters whose contracts are not stable.
SCPN-QC-SIM: Classical and quantum oscillator dynamics, XY/Kuramoto solvers, open-system simulation, tensor-network paths and co-simulation.
SCPN-QC-STUDIO: Quantum Studio's visual workflows, inspectors and evidence presentation through the shared Studio platform contract.
World models / quantum noise: Candidate model family with device calibration epoch as its unit of evidence.

g.title: CONFORMANCE-WITNESS: Check versioned OpenQASM 3, adapter behaviour, provenance fields and repository-evidence criteria against their normative clauses and actual entry points.
DECODER-WITNESS: Compare real decoder engines on released shot data with lossless adapters, declared noise conditions and uncertainty-aware reports.
GRADIENT-WITNESS: Check software derivatives against declared analytic, parameter-shift and finite-difference references, including complex, finite-shot and cross-framework cases.
MITIGATION-WITNESS: Evaluate mitigation on declared measurement panels with retained inputs and uncertainty. Contents are not published. Licence: Not published
g.text: In progress · Contents are not published.

g.title: NOISE-MODEL-WITNESS: Compare model predictions and replay observations for the same circuit and shot identities, with uncertainty, shot floors, calibration epochs and declared tolerances.
QPU-RESULT-PACK: Preserve raw results and their provenance, derivations and reviewable presentation. Contents are not published. Licence: Not published
g.text: In progress · Contents are not published.

g.title: TRANSPILE-WITNESS: Retain scoped observations about compilation semantics, layout, global phase and replay. Contents are not published. Licence: Not published
g.text: In progress · Contents are not published.

g.title: VENDOR-CLAIM-RECOMPUTER: Recompute released-data quantum-volume, error-per-layer-gate and logical-error claims against fixed definitions, original inputs and declared computation budgets.
QUANTUM_LAB: Reserved research workspace name; implementation role is not assigned in the group map.

SC-NEUROCORE: Permanent public development, composition and integration workbench for stochastic and spiking neural modelling, encoding, learning, simulation, selected hardware compilation and evidence inspection.
SC-NC-ANALYSIS: Spike-train analysis, visualisation and explainability.
SC-NC-BENCH: Catalogue/workload suites and immutable source-bound benchmark records.
SC-NC-BRIDGES: Interchange and cross-domain adapters including NIR, quantum, HDC/VSA and neuro-symbolic routes.
SC-NC-CATALOGUE: Neuron models, model zoo and topology/connectome generators.
SC-NC-COMPILER: Equation/IR lowering and hardware collateral for supported numerical models.
SC-NC-CORE: Neuron/synapse primitives, network graph, simulation loop, fixed-point semantics, constants and exceptions.
SC-NC-DATA: Datasets, signal/event encoding, augmentation, codecs, sources and recording adapters.
SC-NC-ENGINE: Accelerated execution and its maintained language/native interfaces.
SC-NC-HARDWARE: Target profiles, mapping, deployment, drivers and power/thermal integration.
SC-NC-LEARN: Training and adaptation, including surrogate gradients, plasticity, online learning, quantisation-aware training and distillation.
SC-NC-RESEARCH: Retained experimental paths, including evolutionary, biological and world-model directions.
SC-NC-STUDIO: Visual composition, inspection and evidence presentation workflows.
SC-NC-VERIFY: Formal, fault, resilience and safety-readiness verification within explicit proof scopes.
SC-NC-BIO: Conditional destination for separately owned biological/biohybrid work if its independent release lifecycle is accepted; current experimental bioware remains in the developmental parent.

g.title: EVIDENCE-MANIFEST-TOOLKIT: Intended purpose: canonicalises, references, seals and verifies evidence with explicit schemas, bounded sources and independently selected policy. Contents are not published. Licence: Not published
g.text: In progress · Contents are not published.

g.title: EXPERIMENT-LEDGER: Records experiment lineage across tools without owning their raw evidence or running their computations.
RANDOMNESS-WITNESS: Assesses number-source suitability for a declared stochastic-computing use; it does not certify randomness for every purpose.
AER-LINK-WITNESS: Measures event-link behaviour under load, including loss, reordering, fairness, starvation and forward progress.
BITSTREAM-EVIDENCE-CI: Captures pinned FPGA build inputs, reports and bitstream identity in a reproducibility-aware chained build ledger.
DEPLOY-PACK: Composes validated deployment evidence with bitstream/driver identity into a verifiable install/update package.
FIELD-OPS-WITNESS: Aggregates compact field health and drift evidence against deployment-time envelopes without actuating devices.
FLIGHT-RECORDER: Retains a bounded per-device event/state history for gap-honest incident reconstruction.

LOOP-TIMING-WITNESS: Fabric-clock instrument for complete control-loop and selected accelerator timing, with simulation/host analysis separated from eventual board timing, fault response and rail-energy evidence.
MODEL-PROVENANCE-PACK: Binds a model's data, training, conversion, quantisation, encoding and supporting evidence into a verifiable provenance pack.
MUTATION-SNN: Measures test adequacy by generating declared semantic mutants and recording what the suite detects.
NEURO-EVIDENCE-BENCH: Executes declared neuromorphic benchmark plans and traces each scoped result back to its raw evidence.
NEURO-SAFETY-CASE: Composes scoped evidence and open gaps into an assessor-facing assurance argument; it certifies nothing itself.
NIR-CONFORMANCE: Tests importer/exporter behaviour against the known semantics of a pinned Neuromorphic Intermediate Representation version.
PLASTICITY-WITNESS: Compares observed learning-rule updates with an independently defined fixed-point or statistical oracle under stated spike/load/fault protocols.
RELIABILITY-WITNESS: Characterises reliability within a declared physical or explicitly simulated exposure, retaining conditions, gaps and rare-event uncertainty.
SC-STREAM-PROVER: Compares realised stochastic-computing arithmetic error with a declared bound for a specific circuit, source and stream-length regime.
SIM-REAL-WITNESS: Quantifies simulation-to-fabric differences for the same model, input and observable population.
SNN-DIVERGENCE-HARNESS: Compares the same network and input across implementations under bit-exact, tolerance or statistical oracles.
SPIKE-CALIBRATOR: Measures classifier confidence against correctness under declared signal definitions, shifts and placements.
SPIKE-CODEC-BENCH: Measures compression of existing spike trains, comparing payload ratio, distortion, encode/decode latency and memory.
SPIKE-ENCODER-CHARACTERISER: Measures the information, spike-rate and latency trade-offs of sensor-to-spike encoders.
SPIKE-FORMAT-BRIDGE: Converts event recordings between declared formats and reports every permitted loss rather than hiding timestamp, polarity or side-stream changes.
SPIKE-GROUNDTRUTH: Generates reproducible event-vision, audio, sensor and control stimuli with ground truth defined by the generator.
SPIKE-LOG: Intended purpose: records, indexes, verifies, slices and replays event streams without losing their provenance or timebase identity. Contents are not published. Licence: Not published
g.text: In progress · Contents are not published.

g.title: SPIKE-QUALITY-GATE: Checks event data against a named quality policy for timestamp, noise, sensor-health, rate, gap and spatial defects.

SC-COMPUTE-ADAPTERS: Owns the SC-NeuroCore-side wrappers and numerical/register/handshake contracts needed to put selected generated peripherals into the independent LOOP-TIMING-WITNESS DUT/capture path.
